--- name: chatGuessGoalSkill description: Guesses the goal a team needs from its recent chat messages and asks the team to confirm it. ---
# Suggest Goal
Guesses the goal a team needs from its recent chat messages and asks the team to confirm it.
## When to use
- The confirmation step of `team_chat_create_goals`.
## How it works
1. Calls the `team_chat_guess_goal` tools function on the thinking LLM with `channelchathistory` and `teaminstruction`. 2. Stores the guess as `suggestedgoal` and `suggestedgoaldetails`. Falls back to `teaminstruction` when there is no guess. 3. Renders `team_chat_create_goals_confirm`, an editable goal with a Create Goal button. It does not run the next step; the button or a typed reply runs `team_chat_create_goals_create`.
## Inputs
- `channelchathistory`: The recent messages in the channel - `teaminstruction`: What the team monitor thought the team asked for, if anything
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `suggestedgoal`, `suggestedgoaldetails`
## Implementation
- Bean `chatGuessGoalSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ChatGuessGoalSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: chatCreateGoalSkill description: Creates the project goal the team confirmed in chat. ---
# Create Goal
Creates the project goal the team confirmed in chat.
## When to use
- After `chatGuessGoalSkill` in `team_chat_create_goals`.
## How it works
1. The goal is the text of a typed reply. When the Create button was used, it is `goaltext` (falling back to `suggestedgoal`). 2. Finds the collection from the channel: a librarycollection, a collectiveproject's `parentcollectionid` or a goaltask's `collectionid`. 3. Creates a `projectgoal` for the user through GoalManager, renders `chat_goal_created`, then runs the children.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `goaltext`: The goal posted by the Create button on `team_chat_create_goals_confirm` - `entityid`: The record the team channel belongs to
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `goal`: the new projectgoal record
## Implementation
- Bean `chatCreateGoalSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ChatCreateGoalSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: goalTaskCreationSkill description: Breaks a goal into up to three tasks using the owner's knowledge base. ---
# Goal Planning
Breaks a goal into up to three tasks using the owner's knowledge base.
## When to use
- After a goal is created, or on a schedule for open goals not yet tagged by the LLM.
## How it works
1. Uses `goal` from the context, or every open goal with `taggedbyllm=false`. 2. Asks the embedding server's `/create_outline` for up to 3 tasks, using the collection and owner documents. 3. Saves each task as a `goaltask` and sets `taggedbyllm` on the goal.
## Inputs
- `goal`: Optional single goal to process
## Outputs
- New `goaltask` records, plus `goalid` and `docids`
## Implementation
- Bean `goalTaskCreationSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.GoalTaskCreationSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: taskCreateChannelSkill description: Opens a chat channel for each pending goal task and posts the task so the team assistant can respond. ---
# Task Channel Creation
Opens a chat channel for each pending goal task and posts the task so the team assistant can respond.
## When to use
- On a schedule, to turn new goal tasks into conversations.
## How it works
1. Finds pending tasks (`taskstatus=0`) of open goals. 2. Creates an `agententitychat` channel for each task if it has none. 3. Posts the task text as the first message for the `team_chat_monitor` scenario, then fires `llm.monitorchats`.
## Inputs
None. It does not read any values from the agent context.
## Outputs
- New channels and first messages for pending tasks
## Implementation
- Bean `taskCreateChannelSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.TaskCreateChannelSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
